WITH p AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j
)
INSERT INTO obs_api_logs (
  created_at, event_type, method, route, status_code, duration_ms, provider, model, client_id, is_error, metadata
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((p.j->>'timestamp')::timestamptz, NOW()),
  COALESCE(p.j->>'kind', 'api_call'),
  p.j->>'method',
  p.j->>'route',
  (p.j->>'statusCode')::int,
  (p.j->>'durationMs')::int,
  p.j->>'provider',
  p.j->>'model',
  p.j->>'clientId',
  COALESCE((p.j->>'isError')::boolean, FALSE),
  COALESCE(p.j->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
FROM p
RETURNING id;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j
)
INSERT INTO obs_error_logs (
  created_at, source, route_or_workflow, status_code, error_code, error_message, metadata
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((p.j->>'timestamp')::timestamptz, NOW()),
  COALESCE(p.j->>'source', 'usami-api'),
  p.j->>'route',
  (p.j->>'statusCode')::int,
  p.j->>'errorCode',
  COALESCE(p.j->>'errorMessage', 'Erro sem mensagem'),
  COALESCE(p.j->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
FROM p
RETURNING id;
